title: Intrinsic Finite-Step Characterizations of Discrete General Helices
summary: We study polygonal general helices in Euclidean three-space using the turning and signed torsion angles of the discrete Frenet frame. For helices whose axis is not orthogonal to the edge tangents, we prove that the global constant-angle condition is equivalent to the existence of a conserved Frenet-frame vector. On the generic branch, elimination of the auxiliary coefficient yields an intrinsic finite-step compatibility relation involving three consecutive turning angles and two consecutive torsion angles.
